articleTitle: Mobile user Location Prediction Based on user Classification and Markov Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Individual's location has play a very important role in mobile network, predicting user's next location in advance has a great effect on optimize network resource and improve user experience. The prediction of mobile user location has become a hot topic of research, but the accuracy of prediction is still a bottleneck. Instead of directly predicting an individual's next location based on the historical data of all users, in this paper, we propose a location prediction method based on the mobile user classification. Firstly, we propose the user classification criteria and the corresponding classification algorithm according to their daily behavior patterns. Secondly, we propose a trajectory prediction scheme for each user cluster based on their characteristics. Using the real cellular network data, simulation results show that the prediction accuracy of the proposed method is up to 66%, which is around 8% higher than the traditional second-order Markov model.

Author Keywords: user classification, location prediction, Markov model, cellular network, mobile user

articleTitle: Mental Health Detection from Speech Signal: A Convolution Neural Networks Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Mental health disorder is a global topic, the current situation is particularly serious in China. The objective and automated detecting of mental health using speech signal has become popular. In the absence of depressed speech corpus, the authors regard depression as a negative emotion, and build the model by Convolution Neural Networks (CNNs), a machine learning method for detecting mental health disorder interchanging with emotional speech. In this experiment, the segmented speech was represented as a spectrogram in the frequency-time domain via a Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT), and these images were as input of the CNNs model. It highlights some advantages that CNNs can offer mental health detection. Results indicate that it is a good attempt and this method can be directly utilized by interchanging with emotional speech.

Author Keywords: mental health, negative emotion, detection, Convolutional Neural Networks

articleTitle: The Value Evaluation of Artificial Intelligence Works of Art
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is not only a technical support of art design, but also a new art form and art type. Artificial intelligence works of art are a new artistic form of integration of contemporary art and technology, and more and more artistic works of artificial intelligence have appeared in the art market. This paper probes into the connotation and development status of AI works of art, the core value of AI works of art based on the comparison of the procedure and method of artistic creation between human works of art and AI works of art. According to the western literary theory and the value evaluation method of general human art works, the evaluation subject of AI art works is analyzed from the aspects of production, circulation, consumption and feedback. The evaluation index of AI art works is put forward from the quantitative level and the evaluation level, and proposed three evaluation principles of AI art works.

Author Keywords: AI Art, Value Evaluation, Human Art, Art Form

articleTitle: Vehicle Object Detection Based on RGB-Camera and Radar Sensor Fusion
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Object detection has always played a major role in the field of computer vision. With the development of faster region-based convolutional neural network (faster-RCNN), single shot multi-box detector (SSD), You Only Look Once (Yolo) and other deep learning networks, 2D object detection has been developed well developed. However, in some key areas, such as driverless vehicles and artificial intelligence robots, cannot meet the requirements of tasks just by detecting two dimensional (2D) objects. So we need to get the three dimensional (3D) position of the object. In 3D object detection, it is difficult to obtain object position information only by red-green-blue (RGB) image. There are some methods to get the 3D position of the target through the point cloud data set. Therefore, this paper proposes a deep learning network, which can combine both color image information and point cloud geometry information, while using MobileNet V3 as the backbone network greatly enhances the operation speed. The region proposal networks (RPN) layer in faster-RCNN is migrated to the network. After testing, the method proposed by us improves obviously in speed and recognition accuracy compared with the previous methods.

Author Keywords: Object detection, faster-RCNN, 3D object, deep learning, radar sensor

articleTitle: Towards the Differences on Deep Learning of Students in Blended Learning Environment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Blended learning has been widely implemented in education and attracted researchers' attention recently. To explore the impact of blended learning environment on students' deep learning, we investigated the learning behaviors and cognitive behaviors in a blended undergraduate course. The study findings inform that learning behaviors of deep learners and surface learners are not completely different, and the vital differences are reflected in some key behaviors, such as the active behaviors in class, the interactional editing behaviors on the learning platform, and the meaning negotiation on cognitive aspect; the behaviors of deep learners are usually in a specific sequence, whereas the behaviors of surface learners are mostly disorder and of single type. The critical method for teachers to facilitate students' deep learning is to pay more attention on key behaviors, as well as to design delicate learning steps to make learners' behaviors happen orderly.

Author Keywords: difference, deep learning, surface learning, blended learning environment

articleTitle: The Influence of Embodied Interactive Action Games on Second Language Vocabulary Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Although various kinds of language teaching aids become more and more powerful, they are favored by a large number of language learners. However, some problems in second language learning have not been well solved. Vocabulary is a key part of second language acquisition. At present, many learners are motivated by external factors to learn. Therefore, second language learners still have serious anxiety. This study helped learners improve their learning experience by integrating embodied interactive games into second language vocabulary learning. Learners used body behavior and voice interaction to learn vocabulary in games, which can help reduce learners' anxiety and boredom. This study compared the vocabulary learning of embodied interactive game with the vocabulary learning based on cards. The results showed that the learners' anxiety was significantly reduced by using embodied interactive games. However, this kind of learning method also causes the decrease of learning performance. We discussed and analyzed the causes of this situation through further interviews with participants and analysis of game design.

articleTitle: Research on Product Design Education Based on Evaluation Grid Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: As far as product design education is concerned, traditional classroom teaching mostly uses desktop research, simple field investigation and non-rigorous interviews as the main means, which often fails to accurately and systematically grasp users' real needs and preferences. The purpose of this study is to explore the new path of product design education, stimulate students' creativity, and ensure that the conceptual scheme designed by students accurately captures user preferences. Firstly, students are required to collect the sample data of the design object through market research and patent query, and use Evaluation Grid Method (EGM) of Miryoku Engineering to extract the attractive factors of the design object. Then, the charm evaluation of users and potential users is obtained by questionnaire survey, and the Quantification Theory Type I (QTT□) is used to analyze the questionnaire data. Finally, the correlation between the specific characteristics of the design object and the demand intention is constructed, which can be used as a reference for students to carry out design innovation. This study is helpful for students to carry out product design practice and improve the scientific and strictness of current product design education.

Author Keywords: design education, product design, miryoku engineering, evaluation grid method, quantification theory type I

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Moving Target Recognition between Faster R-CNN and SSD
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Target detection algorithms based on deep learning and convolutional neural networks (CNN), such as Faster Regionbased Convolutional Neural Network method (R-CNN) and Single Shot Multi-Box Detector (SSD), are superior to traditional algorithms in detection accuracy and speed. However, there is still a lack of detailed research on the different performance between different algorithms. This paper introduces the Faster R-CNN algorithm and SSD algorithm respectively, and implements the algorithm function based on the open source code. In order to evaluate the performance of these two algorithms, a large number of videos containing cars in different scenarios were used for testing. Experimental results show that the former is superior to the latter in recognition accuracy, while the latter is superior to the former in recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Teacher Teaching Competence (TTC) Model Under Smart Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Teacher plays a decisive and important role in the efficient development of the smart classroom. Therefore, it is necessary to deeply explore the competence structure and various competency characteristics of teachers under the smart education. This study used grounded theory, expert consultation, structural equation modeling (SEM) to analyze the questionnaire data to form and test the effectiveness of the teacher teaching competency (TTC) model for the middle school teachers' smart classroom. TTC includes five dimensions of teaching cognition, teaching organization, practical skills, development promotion and professional affection, and 25 competency indicators. This study provided some references for teacher professional development in smart education environment.

articleTitle: Does Time Play a Role?Prediction of Learning Performance with Time-use Habits in Online Assignments
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: For the students, poor time-use habits can easily lead to academic failure. The online learning environment is full of learning resources, and students are not able to get monitor and guide of the teachers face-to-face. Therefore, students are expected to have better time management skills. In this study, 67 middle school students were taken as examples to study their online assignments in LMS in three semesters, and four indicators of time-use habit were constructed: submission, procrastination, speed and regularity. These indicators were used to analyze their prediction effect to students' learning performance. The results show that there is a significant negative correlation between procrastination and learning performance, and the predictive power of procrastination is the best; there is a significant positive correlation between assignments submission times and learning performance and speed is also. While regularity does not show significant correlation with learning performance.

Author Keywords: time management, learning analytics, time use habits, learning performance

articleTitle: Construction of Design Evaluation System Base on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Product design evaluation is the main measure of design scheme optimization. Aesthetics is the emphasis of product design scheme optimization. As aesthetics features subjectivity and fuzziness, different appraisers have different aesthetic evaluation on design works. Due to such subjective mode, the design evaluation activities is in lack of subjectivity and it is not favorable for students to finish design speculation and design scheme optimization. The research is carried out by taking students' interface design coursework for example to judge the degree of influence of aesthetic factors on interface design through fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method and help appraisers compare the interface aesthetics design schemes objectively. Firstly, the expert's comprehensive evaluation is implemented by summarizing aesthetic factors hierarchically through investigation and collection of literature in the research, and importance ranking of different aesthetic factors in interface design is performed by contrast of the the aesthetic influence of the last hierarchy. Then, the precedence relationship matrix is built and converted into the fuzzy consistent judgment matrix. Lastly, the single sorting weight of each hierarchy and overall hierarchical sorting weight is calculated to conclude the aesthetic sorting of each interface design works. According to the research result, it could be found that different aesthetic factors have different degrees of influence on interface aesthetics and objective & rational scheme merit sorting is concluded.

Author Keywords: Fuzzy theory, Interface aesthetics, Design evaluation

articleTitle: Combining Facial Behavioral Cues, Eye Movements and EEG-Based Attention to Improve Prediction of Reading Failure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Educational data mining can extract useful information from students' reading data to predict their reading performance. This study aims to present a model for the identification of students who are likely to fail in reading. To improve predictive performance, multimodal data, facial behavioral cues, eye movements, and EEG-based attention, are combined to predict reading performance. Experimental results revealed that integrating students' external subconscious behaviors and internal cognitive states was complementary to reading performance prediction. Also, the results demonstrated that adding internal data (EEG-based attention) presented a significant improvement in prediction effectiveness beyond using external data (facial behavioral cues and eye movements) alone. Hence, applying EEGbased attention could play an important role in raising the level of prediction quality. The findings contribute to the possibility of promoting students' self-regulated learning and presenting appropriate feedback by instructors. From this, the exploring results support the potential for the improvement of learning engagement in reading.

articleTitle: Research Based on Video Analysis the Integration of the Application of Mathematics Smart Class Teaching Media and Teachers' Knowledge Structure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: There have been a great many of macro studies on the smart class teaching, but insufficient qualitative and quantitative researches on the media application and the teaching structure of the smart class at the micro level. Based on the research framework of classroom-based video analysis, this paper attempts to make a micro level empirical study on the relationship among the teaching behavior, the media application and the teacher's knowledge structure in the smart class by the scientific method of quantitative. On the case analysis of this framework, it will be put forward on a possible path to the deep integration of the media application and the teacher's knowledge structure in the smart class.

Author Keywords: Smart Class, Video Analysis, TPACK, Quantitative analysis

articleTitle: The Effect of Virtual Reality Technology on College Students' Interest in Sports Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to explore the influence of virtual reality technology on college students' interest in sports learning. This paper applies virtual reality technology to table tennis teaching practice, and constructs a new teaching mode with teachers as the leading role and students as the main body. In this study, 19 non-sports major students were selected as subjects, and a single-subject experiment was conducted to evaluate the indicators of interest in sports situations in the pre-experiment and post-experiment stages in a four-week intervention experiment from June to July 2019. The results show that the use of virtual reality games in table tennis learning can improve students' interest in sports learning, learning attitude is more positive.

Author Keywords: virtual reality technology, College students, interest in sports learning

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of K12 Teachers' Information Technology Literacy
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Information technology provides a virtual and practical learning environment for education, whose virtual "intelligent agent" extends, strengthens and complements the intelligence of human brain, and changes interaction between former learning subjects and between learning subjects and learning environment, and also has changed learner learning ecology. Research adopts mainly method of "Empirical Content Analysis" to explore the essential facts, trends and forecast on the development tendency on policy text of "ICT-CFT" of UNESCO and "Ability standard", Meanwhile, to find out difference between "ICT-CFT" of UNESCO and "Ability standard", with quantitative and qualitative content analysis. Competency Framework of the "ICT-CFT" and " Capability Standard" are designed to promote the learning experience of teachers and students in curriculum, to support study of a course or subject-specific course of instruction and to promote Information Technology Literacy. To take the information unit project, theme, sentence, the paragraph and space-time concept in the policy text as the technical unit, This research adopts the Experimental Content Analysis method which contains six parts, to establish the goals, to determine the research overall, to select the analysis unit, to formulate coding catalogue, sampling and quantifying analysis materials, decision record and analysis corollary. Therefore, A policy analysis framework, which contains 4 primary classification indicators and 12 secondary classification indicators, based on the policy text subject, the policy text target, the policy text scheme, and the effect of the policy, has been designed to analyze and deduce relationship between the conceptual elements and the organizational structure in the text, lastly to present the basic facts, value orientation, and the development trend differently. To provides reference for the policy formulation and future development direction of teachers' information technology literacy in our country.

articleTitle: Academic Planning and Career Choice of Art Doctoral Students in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The development of artificial intelligence has profoundly changed the education, work and life of human beings. As the implementation stage of academic planning and the preparation stage of career choice, how to recognize, understand, set and shape their own social role and dynamically adjust their own academic planning is the primary task and core work that every doctoral student of art discipline must face. From the perspective of the influence of art as an independent discipline and artificial intelligence on academic planning, this paper probes into the problems such as the lack of discipline consciousness, the confusion of discipline concept, the lack of academic responsibility, the narrow field of vision, the weakening of ideals and beliefs and the confusion of career choice. This paper probes into the academic planning, life ideal, academic goal and career development of doctoral students in art, and provides inspiration and reference for the academic planning, career choice and self-development of doctoral students in art.

articleTitle: Computer Science Unplugged for Developing Computational Thinking and Mathematical Thinking
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to make learning material that can develop both Computational thinking and Mathematical thinking. This study suggest a hamburger flowchart as a teaching material that combines the three elements of "unplugged", "thinking from the end " and "mathematics class". Using this flowchart, basic experiment was conducted for 8 to 12 years old. The purpose of this experiment is to confirm whether it is possible for children to develop both Computational thinking and Mathematical thinking by using the hamburger flowchart. We evaluated both Computational thinking and Mathematical thinking from the state in this class and the content of the worksheet and prior and subsequent tests. As a result, the state related to Computational thinking and Mathematical thinking increased, and the correct answer rate of many children increased from the prior test to the subsequent test. Therefore it turned out that the hamburger flowchart affects mathematical thinking.

articleTitle: Media Development in the Background of Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Since the rapid development of Artificial Intelligence in 2017, Artificial Intelligence has gradually penetrated from an abstract scientific concept into various entities of our lives. The government's report on the two sessions held in March 2018 once again mentioned "Strengthening the research and application of the new generation of Artificial Intelligence, promoting 'Internet +' in many fields such as health care, pension, education, culture, sports and so on." Artificial Intelligence has become the infrastructure of national strategy. Nowadays, all kinds of media are developing together to spread the power of science and technology. With regard to how to explore and find a more suitable way of media convergence of "Artificial Intelligence +" for the development of China's media, the new communication revolution represented by the Internet is reconstructing our real world, and the new technologies are creating a new social form and building a new social relationship, which puts forward a series of new requirements for the development and innovation of Chinese media. Since it is difficult for traditional theoretical and practical paradigms to solve a series of new formats, mechanisms and logic brought about by new technologies, the development and operation have become the top priority for the development of media and a problem that we need to think deeply at present.

articleTitle: Improving Design and Creative Ability of High School Students through Project Based Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In 2018, the Ministry of Education issued General Senior High School Information Technology Curriculum Standard (2017). The new curriculum standard puts forward the concept of subject core literacy and requires project-based learning. The paper combines the design thinking concept of Stanford University with the project-based learning, redesigns the project-based learning mode, and carries on the teaching experiment, the experiment object is 40 senior two students. The experiment found that the project-based learning mode combined with design thinking has a positive effect on improving students' learning effect, innovation ability and core literacy. The students' learning enthusiasm, self-satisfaction and innovation ability are obviously improved. Through the interview, it is found that the students have also made some breakthroughs in their sense of social responsibility and empathy.

articleTitle: Construction of Educational Resources and Design of Learning Activities in Facilitating Museum Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Museum has abundant research resources of history, art, and science, and displays the knowledge in an intuitive and vivid way. The educational environment of museums is designed to enhance students' curiosity and interest. Based on the analysis of the current situation of museum education, this paper carries out field investigation and research around the resources, environment and learning activities in the museums, to explore the socialization mode of museum education and to excavate the educational nature of museum resources and environment. The purpose of this paper is to provide a reference for the construction of extracurricular inquiry learning and social lifelong learning system.

articleTitle: Research on Product Modeling Design Program Based on Finite Structure Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In order to enable students to obtain more effective and reliable modeling scheme in the stage of product modeling deliberation, a set of product modeling design program suitable for classroom teaching is constructed based on the method of finite structure analysis (FSM). Firstly, the product main function system is decomposed into several secondary functions by the method of limited structure analysis, and the secondary functions are re-structured and the spatial layout is changed to deduce a variety of modeling schemes. Then, combining with clay model making method, the details of the obtained scheme are deliberated, and then the most reliable design scheme is obtained through comprehensive and objective evaluation and screening by PUGH decision matrix method. Finally, the feasibility and validity of the above methods are verified by the example of the vaneless fan modelling research, which provides support for students to use rational thinking in product modelling design.

Author Keywords: form design, finite structure method, clay model, professor Stuart Pugh’s decision matrix method

articleTitle: Applying Python in Brain Science Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The research of brain science provides new concepts and new ideas for revealing human brain cognitive processes and promoting brain-inspired computing models. Python and its powerful technology ecosystem provide support for the teaching and practice of brain science. In this paper, the related resources in the Python ecosystem of neuroimaging technologies were used as teaching and practice materials. This article discussed how to use Python and corresponding development tools to complete neuroimaging data preprocessing, functional connectivity analysis, multivoxel pattern analysis, and searchlight analysis in brain science teaching, and the corresponding practice processes were also demonstrated with examples. By applying Python and technologies in the ecosystem to the theoretical and practical teaching of brain science related professional courses, students can better integrate with artificial intelligence technology while learning brain science research techniques.

Author Keywords: Python, brain science education, functional connectivity, multivoxel pattern analysis, searchlight analysis

articleTitle: A Deep Neural Network Approach for Mobile Edge Computation Offloading
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Mobile computation offloading, which sending part or all of the computing tasks of the SMDs (smartphone mobile devices) to the server side with richer resources, effectively breaking the resource limitation of the mobile devices. The offloading decision algorithm plays a core role in the mobile computation offloading technology. Existing research work mainly studies the computational offloading problem based on graphs, trees, and integer linear programming. We attribute a computation offloading problem to a combinatorial optimization problem and design a deep learning neural network architecture to solve it. The experimental results show that the proposed approach achieves the close effect of the optimal solution.

Author Keywords: mobile edge computing, pointer network, Multidimensional knapsack problem

articleTitle: Peer Assessment Using SPARKPLUS for Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Self and Peer Assessment Resource Kit (SPARKPLUS), a web based peer assessment tool was applied to moderate individual grades for a Civil Engineering course at the University of South Australia in 2018. Nine criteria under three categories were considered to evaluate individual and team performance for ninety seven enrolled students. Each group consisted three to four students and five points rating scales were utilized. Rated peer factor was used to judge individual performance in the team, while the team performance was weighed using radar diagram. It was observed that SPARKPLUS is a user friendly effective tool to value the peer assessment for groups of engineering students.

articleTitle: Development of Android-Based Quiz Video Game: Mathventure
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This study aims to build an Android-based quiz video game. This video game application is designed using the Game Development Life Cycle (GDLC) process model. That starts from, the initiation stage, followed by the stages of preproduction, production, then video games are tested internally and externally (beta), until later it will be released in general. The results of this study are Android-based quiz video game prototypes. This video game takes the form of a fight between two magicians. This game features single player and two-player. Each player fights by answering the true-false questions which can be chosen by taping the selected option. With this gameplay it is expected to be able to practice cognitive abilities remembering, understanding, and evaluating the players.

articleTitle: Observing Creative Characteristics in Solving Fermi-Tasks by the Modelling and Creating Activity Diagram
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In didactics, Fermi questions are usually discussed under the aspect of modelling. The aspect of creativity is not considered very much. This paper is intended to show a way in which selected characteristics of creative solutions can be made observable. Therefore the Modelling Activity Diagram will be modified to a Modelling and Creating Activity Diagram.

articleTitle: Social Anxiety and Study Engagement in Adolescents: The Role of Self Cognition Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Study engagement is a positively learning status among adolescents. The aim of this study was to test if self-concept clarity and intentional self-regulation mediate between social anxiety and study engagement. Participants were 1597 Chinese adolescents (48.2%male, aged 13-23 years, M=17.45 years, SD=3.04 ;) they completed measures of social anxiety self-concept clarity, intentional self-regulation and study engagement. The study used structural equation modeling to test for a mediating effect; self-concept clarity and intentional self-regulation were found to fully mediate between social anxiety and study engagement. ISR and SCC indirectly affected SE had no significant. These findings suggest that self-concept clarity and intentional self-regulation underlie social effect on adolescents' study engagement.

Author Keywords: —social anxiety, study engagement, adolescents, self concept clarity, intentional self regulation

articleTitle: Mapping Analysis of Student`s Core-Competencies in University (Case: Department of Information System, State Islamic University of Sulthan Syarif Kasim Riau, Indonesia)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Core-competence is allowing university to be creative and adaptable on their student's capabilities by mapping their student's research focus. In order to be successful of core-competences goals, department strategy, student, and lecturer are crucial role in that process. However, previous study offered more general contexts and cases of competence mapping approach while less or misplaced discussed more technical process in higher education environment. Therefore, to fill out the research gap, this research examines whether and why competence mapping can help university to prepare their graduations candidate. We evaluated two core-competences which are information system management and information system engineering by checking several main construct such as information technology quality management, knowledge management, and information technology risk management. The data collected from students in department of information system, state islamic university of sulthan syarif kasim Riau, Indonesia. The results from our analysis support that students who focused on information system management (ISM) focus were 37.8%, and in information system engineering (ISE) were 2.7%, and students who taken both ISM and ISE were 59.5 %. Regarding the result, the authors concluded that students more prefer to take more or combining two fields (ISM and ISE). More theoretical and practical implications are discussed.

Author Keywords: Core-Competencies Mapping, Information System, University, Information System Management (ISM), Information System Engineering (ISE).

articleTitle: Research on the Difference of user Avoidance Behavior of Multi-device Video Advertisement
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In the era of multi-screen, users acquire information and entertainment through smartphones, personal computer (PC), tablets and other devices. At present, most of the advertisers distribute the advertisements (ads) to multiple devices in order to cover a larger area of users and achieve better effect, however they ignore the differences in user behavior at different devices. This study explored the different avoidance strategies of users when they faced video ads on PC and mobile phones, which were influenced by both technical and content factors. The purpose of this study was to probe the impact of different devices and advertisement length (ad length) on users' advertising avoidance behavior, and to provide insightful and targeted suggestions for multi-screen advertising placement. This study found that device and ad length were interrelated, and affected users' advertising avoidance behavior together. This study proposed that there were differences in the users' functional positioning of the phone and PC, which may lead to different behaviors of users at different devices. The study suggested that future researchers could investigate the psychological time differences of different device users, and consider the possible impact of multi-device cognitive load on user duration judgment.

Author Keywords: multi-device, ad length, advertising avoidance, internet video advertising

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Digital TV Interactive Function on User's Video-on-Demand Willingness: A Survey on College Students
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, new media has gradually penetrated into the public life, and the interactive function embodied by digital TV has become a highlight of attracting audiences. This study takes college students as the research object, attempt to use the MUG model, studies how the digital TV interactive function affects the user's Video-on-Demand (VOD) willingness. The study found that the two factors of Content and Emotion have a positive influence on the user's willingness to use digital TV interactive functions, and Ease of use, Promotion, and Madefor-the-medium are negative correlation. The results of data analysis show that the MUG model can be used to study the factors influence the interactive function of digital TV used by college students.

Author Keywords: Digital TV, Interactive, VOD Willingness, MUG

articleTitle: Investigations of Verbal Cues and Self-Voice Perception Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: It is of great significance to explore the influence mechanism of verbal cues on self-voice perception under different conditions. The aim of this study is to probe the effects of verbal and non-verbal conditions on implicit task (experiment 1) and explicit task (experiment 2) of self-voice. Binaural auditory channels were used to present two voices successively, and the speakers included the participants, familiar and strangers. In the experiment 1, participants were asked to judge whether the pair of stimuli were pronounced by the same speaker. In the experiment 2, participants were asked to identify whether one of the stimuli was their own voice. The results show that there is no difference in individual voice perception of self (vs. non-self) under different conditions of verbal cues in the implicit task. In the explicit task, there is less accuracy in recognizing the voice of self than that of non-self. It is also found that there exists no difference in individual self-voice perception at different levels of factors.

articleTitle: Visual Analysis of MOOC Research Using Citespace from 2012 to 2018
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Having risen the attention of both researchers and practitioners, MOOC is becoming a hot research topic in the field of online learning and educational technology. This paper presents a visual analysis and systematic review of MOOC literature from 2012-2018. A literature visualization software named CiteSpace has been used to map the research results. A total number of 2056 of papers about MOOC and associated 20679 references have been collected as source data. The key authors, influential institutions, top keywords, influential journals, and future research trends in this field have been identified. The combination of different concepts, solving the realistic problem of MOOC, deeper integration of learning analytics and MOOC, the design of gamification enhanced MOOC are major trends in MOOC research. We recommend researchers may consider other research methods besides experimental research, such as neuro science design to study MOOC.

articleTitle: A Meta-Learning-Based Solution to Address the Sparsity Problem of Recommender Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Sparsity is an important challenge for recommender systems. Most of the existing solutions to sparsity problem are achieved by adding auxiliary data. However, in practical recommender systems, auxiliary data is often difficult to obtain and limited in number. Considering the characteristics of data sparsity, this paper transforms it into a meta-learning problem. We propose a new meta-learning solution based on multi-layer perception (MLP) network to solve the sparsity problem of recommender systems from the perspective of optimizing parameters with a network using meta-learning. We split the behavior data into small sets by users and consider the training process of a small set as a task, and train an MLP network through these tasks to learn a parameter-optimizing strategy of the recommendation model. The network can quickly fit the extremely sparse data and optimize recommendation model parameters. We then predict the recommendation results on the test set with the optimized model parameters. Experiments on movielens and NetFlixPrize datasets show that the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) value of the reference recommendation model with meta-MLP increases by 1%-10% when the data sparsity is less than 0.001%.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Primary School Mathematics Teaching Activities Based on Augmented Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, new forms of education continue to emerge. Augmented reality as a new type of technical means to provide educators with new ways of teaching. This paper takes the firstgrade mathematics curriculum as the research orientation and designs a teaching model based on augmented reality technology. First, we combed the basic definition of Augmented Reality and its advantages, and designed the corresponding teaching system through analytical learning theory. Secondly, it expounded the specific interaction mode of Augmented Reality technology in mathematics teaching. Finally, we designed a course to further explain the potential feasibility of augmented reality-based mathematics curriculum system design, and conducted some user research and related discussions. Hoping to provide some reference for the theoretical research and practical application of augmented reality technology in the future.

articleTitle: A Cold Thinking on the Development of STEM Education
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: STEM Education is an interdisciplinary field that integrates science, technology, engineering and mathematics. It aims to cultivate students' creativity and problem-solving ability. STEM Education has been spread nationwide. This paper firstly introduces the meaning and development of STEM Education, reflects on its promotion and development process, then points out the problems and challenges in the promotion of STEM education. In addition, this paper offers some suggestions on how to promote STEM Education more effectively from the theoretical and practical level, expecting to provide useful reference for the launch of STEM Education in China.

articleTitle: Why College Students Watch Streaming Drama at Higher Playback Speed:The Uses and Gratifications Perspective
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This study examines why college students watch streaming drama at higher playback speed by applying the uses and gratifications theory. An online survey completed by 204 college students identified six different motivations for higher-playback speed usage: time efficiency, psychological repellence to plot-dragging slow-paced drama, herd mentality, personal preference, entertainment, and curiosity, each can be ranked by the level of gratification. The greatest gratification was for time efficiency, pursuing a fast-paced life; followed by curiosity and entertainment; ended with escaping from the stresses and recognition from others.

Author Keywords: higher playback speed, Uses and Gratifications, streaming drama, college student

articleTitle: Understanding Rural and Urban Teachers' ICT Usage in China: An Ecological Perspective
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Rural schools are considered the "final mile" in China's Educational Technology Plan (2011-2020). The current study uses semi-structured group interviews with 174 teachers from 26 schools spread widely across Fujian province in order to explore the gaps between rural and urban teachers' use of technology and the obstacles they encounter in this area. The results of the comparison indicate two important differences between two groups. One is that rural teachers comparatively rarely used the interactive functions available to them for their own presentations and instead let their students use the available technologies. The other difference we found demonstrates that the two key factors to hinder rural teachers' technology integration are the higher malfunction rate of teaching devices (combined with delayed repairs) and the perception that there were few advantages to the technology when it came to improve their students' generally low-test scores. To use an ecological metaphor, our findings suggest that the equipment malfunctions, usually worsened by delayed maintenance, have disrupted the environment and make it difficult for an invading species - technology - to survive. Moreover, fewer and lower perceived advantages for their students have strongly hindered rural teachers' willingness to try new technologies, thus decreasing the opportunities for mutual adaptation between technology and teacher. Policymakers should use this knowledge to develop future decisions.

Author Keywords: Rural and Urban Teachers, ICT Integration, Ecosystem

articleTitle: An Investigation on the Factors Influencing Preservice Information Technology Teacher's TPACK Level in China
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The TPACK framework of integrated technology provides guidance for teachers' information-based teaching. However, researches on present situation and influencing factors of TPACK level of pre-service information technology teachers are not enough. This study enriches the interaction between teachers' TPACK development influencing factors and technical knowledge, subject content knowledge and pedagogy knowledge, and complements the theoretical research of TPACK. Therefore, based on the TPACK framework, the study explores the TPACK level and factors influencing pre-service information technology teachers' TPACK level in China. Firstly, it is developed "pre-service information technology teachers TPACK level questionnaire" and "pre-service information technology teachers TPACK influencing factors questionnaire". Secondly, 110 pre-service information technology teachers are selected as research objects. Finally, it is carried out that relevant analysis with SPSS software. The results show that the four influencing factors(usefulness of technology, external factors, technology's ease of use, computer self-efficacy) have greater effect on teachers' TPACK knowledge structure. The usefulness of technology is significantly correlated with CK, PCK, TPK and TPACK levels. Technical ease of use has a strong influence on all seven factors of TPACK. External factors and computer self-efficacy can promote the improvement of TK knowledge.

articleTitle: Improving Mandarin Chinese Learning in Tibetan Second-Language Learning by Artificial Intelligent Speech Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Mandarin plays an important role in the world and it is also the national common language in China that means mandarin need to be also popularized in ethnic minority areas. Tibetan is located in remote areas and their language is mainly Tibetan, which makes it difficult for Tibetan students to learn Mandarin and it has seriously affected the popularization of Mandarin in minority areas. Therefore, this paper proposed an effective method to assist Tibetan students' second language learning by using intelligent speech technology. Firstly, speech recognition algorithm is adopted to detect pronunciation errors. Secondly, speech synthesis method is utilized to correct pronunciation errors. And thirdly, the STRAIGHT algorithm is used to adjust speaking rate to further help Tibetan students understand the correct pronunciation. We carry out the experiment with 20 Tibetan students and the results shows that the method can effectively reduce the error rate of Mandarin pronunciation and improve the accuracy of learning Mandarin. The result also shows that as the speaking rate becomes slower, the comprehension accuracy increases.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Status Management System Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: For the weak data interaction between the platforms of the distribution network, the low degree of information fusion between the systems and the massive operational monitoring data, the traditional distribution network operation state control system can not meet the monitoring requirements. Therefore, this paper proposes a distribution network state control system based on big data and cloud platform, by introducing micro-service technology, massive data distributed storage technology and cross-region collaboration technology, the system can realize access processing and deep mining analysis of massive data, dynamic configuration of resources and flexible expansion of the system. In turn, the operation level of the distribution network is improved, and the lean management level of the distribution network is improved.

Author Keywords: cloud platform, distribution network status management system component, microservices, big data

articleTitle: Patent Analysis and Suggestion of Network Function Virtualization Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Network virtualization technology (NFV) is one of the key network technologies in the development of 5G technology. The article analyzes NFV technology from application trend, technology trend, patent competition, PCT application and patent citation. It provides corresponding conclusions and suggestions for China's communication industry and promotes the prosperity and development of China's communication industry by analyzing the development status and future trends of NFV technology.

articleTitle: Construction of Primary and Secondary School Teachers' ICT Application Micro-Competence Framework
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to construct micro-competence framework and mine the relationship among micro-competences. It provides graph support for the intelligent push of teachers' ICT application competence assessment task. In view of the limitations of the current competence assessment, by analyzing the principles and basis for construction of micro-competence framework. This paper puts forward the ideas and methods of collaborative construction of domain experts and machines. Based on the Standard for Primary and Secondary School Teachers' ICT Application Competence (Trial). The author decomposes teachers' ICT application competence with reference to relevant standards, documents and research results at home and abroad, and determines micro-competence and its weight through expert consultation. Finally, micro-competence framework was constructed, the ideas and methods of mining the relationship among micro-competences using association rules algorithm were putting forward.

Author Keywords: micro competence framework, micro-competence graph, teachers' ICT application competence, intelligent assessment

articleTitle: Discussion on the Application of Video Resource Teaching Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Compared with the traditional teaching mode, video resource teaching can use the unique film and television language to spread the teaching information in a simple way, so that the teaching effect can be achieved with less effort. But this must be based on the correct use of video resources, and in the application process, we need to consider the content selection of video resources and audience analysis. This process involves the interaction between various entities, how to better handle it. These factors, which have a positive effect, are the focus of this article.

Author Keywords: video resources, video resource application method, video resource application effect

articleTitle: An Improved Approach to Speaker Recognition for Broadcast News Audio
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The goal of this paper is speaker recognition in broadcast news domain. The broadcast news audio is variable in length and accents, and also contains irrelevant signals, such as environment sounds. This paper proposes a two-path neural network to learn the embedding of speakers, one of which focuses on local (detail) features and the other focuses on global features. The features of the two networks will be merged, and new speaker embedding is proposed from these features. For the local network, this paper also aggregates its features by GhostVLAD algorithm. And GhostVLAD algorithm is formalized in this paper. The final result shows that Dual-vector has achieved remarkable results in the field of speaker recognition for broadcast news audio.

Author Keywords: Speaker Recognitio, GhostVLAD, A-softmax, CNN, DNN

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Analysis of Singing Effects Based on Pulse Waves
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In recent years, singing and dancing have become a common way for the elderly to exchange entertainment. The generated pulse waves contain important information, and we can analyze the pulse waves to analyze the change in their mental state. In this study, the pulse waves were measured before and after the singing activity in daily life, and the LLE (largest Lyapunov exponent) and ANB (autonomic nerve balance) were calculated. It was found that after singing, the LLE will rise and the ANB will converge around 5. It can be thought that singing is a way of regulating mental state.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Reform of the People's Jury System — Combined with the Jury Law
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Based on written judgments of administrative cases manually collected from "China Judgment Online", the "Microscopic Data Set of Maoming Municipal Administrative Proceedings for 2018" is built to empirically study the influence of the age, education and collegiate type of the people's jurors on the plaintiff's win rate . Verify the correlation between the plaintiff's success rate in the administrative cases in Mainland China and the age, education and collegiate type of the people's jurors, and further study how to optimize the comprehensive selection system.

articleTitle: Business Intelligence Application of Enhanced Learning in Big Data Scenario
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The arrival of the era of big data has made the type and distribution of business data structure change qualitatively. In some scenarios, traditional business intelligence tools have been unable to meet the needs of modern enterprise intelligent decision-making. This paper introduces the background of zero inventory case and the current situation of zero inventory, and then validates the specific application process of reinforcement learning method in business intelligence by analyzing the application example of zero inventory in enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Voice Conversion from Tibetan Amdo to U-Tsang Dialect Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Tibetan Amdo dialect and Tibetan U-tsang dialect belong to the same dialect system of Tibetan. Although they use the same handwritten language, huge differences in pronunciation are caused by historical changes and geographical environment. As a result, Tibetans among different dialects have great difficulties in face-to-face communication. Therefore, we propose a method to realize voice conversion from Amdo dialect to U-tsang dialect. In this work, the problem of voice conversion from Amdo to U-tsang dialect is addressed leveraging upon deep learning framework. The deep model would function as a speech recognizer for Amdo and speech synthesizer for U-tsang. A pronunciation mapping table from one dialect to the other would also be built, which will be used to map phone sequences of U-tsang to Amdo and vice-versa. In the experiment, the input of Amdo dialect speech can be recognized as phoneme sequences. Through the phoneme mapping table, the phoneme sequences of U-tsang dialect are obtained. Then, we use them to synthesize U-tsang dialect speech. In this way, the voice conversion from Tibetan Amdo to U-tsang dialect based on deep learning in non-parallel corpus can be realized. The experiment results show that the converted speech quality and intelligibility are reliable and the original Tibetan Amdo and converted Tibetan U-tsang dialect share many similarities in duration and pitch.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Characteristics and Typical Projects of Task-Based Massive Open Online Courses (tMOOC)
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Type analysis of MOOCs is a basic research. In reality, MOOCs are usually divided into cMOOC and xMOOC, which is reasonable to some extent, but not universally explanatory. Mainly based on Lisa M. Lane's opinion that MOOCs contain network-based, task-based and content-based MOOC, task-based MOOC (tMOOC), a relatively independent MOOC, is different from the others. It respects differences of learners' previous knowledge and the uniqueness of knowledge creation according to Constructivism Learning Theory and the main aim at acquiring specific skills in generating knowledge. This paper also analyzes typical application of it when applying MOOC.

Author Keywords: Massive Open Online Courses (MOOC), Task based Constructivism Learning Theory

articleTitle: Construction and Empirical Analysis of the Content System of Vocational Education Teachers' Information Technology Ability Training
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Based on the information technology competence standards of foreign vocational teachers, this paper analyzes in detail the information technology content of vocational education teacher training in China, and combines the "National Training" project carried out by Gansu Province to provide information technology skills for 300 vocational teachers in cities and counties of Gansu Province. The investigation was carried out, and the principal component analysis method was used to analyze the factors of 42 competences. Finally, six competency factors were extracted, and the content system of information technology competency training for vocational teachers was constructed. The differences in information technology ability of vocational teachers in different backgrounds were analyzed. Finally, relying on the "National Training" project to conduct an empirical analysis of the training content system and verify the training effect.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Eye Movement in the Process of Animation Multimedia Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In recent years, the research of multimedia learning is shifting from the traditional static research of combining picture and text to the dynamic research of combining animation (video) and sound. New experimental techniques based on eye movement behavior and brain data analysis are rapidly developing and maturing. On the one hand, the experimental study on eye movement behavior of multimedia learning can reveal the real-time information processing mechanism of learners' multimedia learning process. On the other hand, it can also open up new development fields and provide new research technology routes for traditional multimedia learning. The eye movement experiment of animation multimedia learning shows that the process of multimedia information processing by learners presents double situational nature; the process of learning information processing by learners needs to integrate text information and picture information organically, which is significantly different in different situations.

articleTitle: A Reconsideration of Newspaper Reports Regarding PM2.5 Problems in China Under the Perspective of Risk Communication: Based on the Content Analysis of the Reports of "People's Daily" from Jan.1, 2012 to Dec.31, 2016
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Under the influence of various risks, the current Chinese Society has entered a complex period in which it is being compelled to deal with not only worldwide risks, but also China's inherent risks. Based on these circumstances, it is vital to improve public cognition and perception of risks and to promote risk communication. This study focused on the issue of PM2.5 particles and discussed it from the viewpoint of risk communication in China's risk society. In this study, a quantitative content analysis of the reports in the People's Daily newspaper from 2012.1.1 to 2016.12.31 was conducted to analyze the characteristics of the PM2.5 reports and the changes from the past reports about air pollution. Based on the results, accompanying the process of a risk society, the contents and tones of the reports were approaching the public and the method of making to citizens aware has been diversified. Regarding the relationship between the risk society and media, the coverage of PM2.5 plays a role in the function of risk forecast, risk-information need, risk anxiety reduction and science education.

articleTitle: Core Skill Development of New Media Marketers Based on Job Competency Model
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Under the new circumstances of "Internet+", new media market not only requires market segmentation and integration, but is also in urgent need of intellectuals, which poses a new challenge to college educations. According to the latest data on recruitment sites, there emerged a huge gap between supply and demand of intellectuals in the new media area. This scarcity urges colleges and universities to cultivate professional intellectuals that meet the needs of market. The author creates a "T" model for new media marketing intellectuals, providing possible training strategies for "T" model intellectual cultivation, and contributing to college curriculum reform in cultivating new media intellectuals.

Author Keywords: T Model Intellectual Structure, professional intellectual, "1+2+X" Model, Tutorial System

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Mode of Junior Middle School Information Technology Based on Critical Thinking Process
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Critical thinking is one of the core abilities and skills needed in the 21st century. Critical thinking can stimulate students to explore and make them good at inventing. Junior high school is the golden period for the development of students' thinking ability, and their thinking habits have not yet been fixed, so they are in urgent need of correct guidance and development. Based on the analysis of the connotation and process of critical thinking, this paper puts forward a new teaching mode for the cultivation of critical thinking in junior middle school students. The junior high school teaching mode based on the cultivation of critical thinking can promote the development of junior high school students' critical thinking and the comprehensive quality ability of information technology disciplines. The model of critical thinking training for junior middle school students has great reference significance and practical guidance to subject teaching.

Author Keywords: critical thinking, junior high school teaching, teaching mode

articleTitle: Evaluation and Research on the Design Ability of Teachers' Inquiry Learning Activities
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In the context of the development of intelligent education, the assessment of teachers' cognitive skills in information technology has been paid more and more attention by researchers. Therefore, this study carried out the assessment and research on the micro-ability of teachers' cognitive skills in information technology. Based on the loop model of analyzing the internal process of learning activities put forward by Romisosky, the study firstly divided the task dimension of teachers' cognitive skills into pre-knowledge assessment and applied pre-knowledge assessment. Secondly, different data acquisition indicators, data acquisition methods, data scoring methods and scoring standards are used for evaluation. Data acquisition and analysis are carried out according to multiple-choice answers and platform automatic saving. In the final result report section, not only the overall result of the evaluation, but also the comparison table of expert design scheme is given, so that teachers can understand the similarities and differences between their own design and expert design, and make timely adjustments and Suggestions for teachers' problems in the evaluation. The research shows that the platform-based cognitive skills assessment of teachers can measure the ability of teachers to explore learning activities, push personalized teaching design resources, and provide references for improving teachers' cognitive skills of information technology.

articleTitle: Application of Portfolio in Problem-Based Learning of Clinical Surgery
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Objective To explore the application of Portfolio in problem-based learning of clinical surgery and improve the quality of teaching. Methods Group teaching for students, only the experimental group applied the portfolio, and the teaching results were counted. Results The experimental group students have higher final exam scores and good self-evaluations of themselves. Conclusion More application of portfolio should be tried in problem-based learning of clinical surgery.

articleTitle: Construction of Art Training System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Digital media art is not only a new development direction for undergraduate majors in educational technology, but also a combination of art education with new media education. As a new professional digital media talent training model, it has different characteristics from other directions of educational technology. Based on the problems in the training of Chinese digital media education, this paper analyzes the weaknesses in the training of digital media talents in colleges and universities. By examining the relevant theories, it designs and develops an art training system based on virtual reality technology, which can help students carry out the painting practice and artistic creation of constructive knowledge. Preliminary experiments have studied the attitudes of students to the knowledge of the composition after the use of the system. As indicated by the result, students have significantly improved their attitude towards learning and artistic creation after using the system, which provides reference suggestion for further teaching plan design of digital media art major.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Lifestyle and Food Safety Risk Information Sharing Intention
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to explore the differences in food safety risk information sharing intentions among different clusters. 347 valid questionnaires were collected through the network questionnaire. The digital lifestyle was divided into seven dimensions by the exploratory factor analysis. Through the cluster analysis, consumers were divided into three clusters: digital technology enthusiasts, digital technology laggards, digital technology neutrals. The results of the one-way multivariate analysis of variance (one-way MANOVA) showed that there were significant differences between the digital technology enthusiasts and the digital technology laggards in the public and non-public sharing intentions of food safety risk information, and there were significant differences between the digital technology laggards and the digital technology neutrals in the non-public sharing intentions.

articleTitle: Video Game Design and Performance Analysis Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The Reinforcement Learning (RL) implement real-time decision-making behavior in uncertain environment in order to optimize overall target. RL is considered to be the paradigm of future general artificial intelligence (AI) because it is very similar to the way human thinks, which is expected to be widely used in game designing. In order to make RL algorithm perform better in video games, the model-free algorithm is used and convolutional neural network (CNN) is used in the pre-processing. In this paper, the performance of Deep Q Network (DQN) and Double Deep Q Network (DDQN) algorithms were tested and compared in the "Arkanoid Game". The experiment shows that the DQN algorithm has a problem of overestimating the Q value and the DDQN algorithm can solve it well. In addition, the two algorithms are similar in terms of loss changes, but the learning effect of DDQN performs better.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Relationship between Media Usage and Immersive Tendency
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Many studies have applied immersion tendency to divide users and predict their immersion before experiments. The immersion tendency questionnaire (ITQ) has been widely adopted in the measurement and classification of subjects. This study found that the results of dimension division were not consistent with the original ITQ (18 items) dimension division through factor analysis. Moreover, the present study showed that the media forms involved in items had certain influence on the division of dimensions through the analysis of the content of items. Further canonical correlation analysis proved that media usage was highly correlated with the immersion tendency measured by ITQ. These results suggested that the influence of media usage should be taken into account when revising or supplementing ITQ in future studies.

Author Keywords: Immersive tendency questionnaire, Media usage, Immersion, Virtual reality

articleTitle: Kham Dialect Speech Synthesis Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In this paper, we constructed speech synthesis corpus of Kham dialect. At the same time, we designed SAMP-Kham machine-readable phonetic label of Kham dialect, and proposed a framework of Kham dialect speech synthesis based on deep learning. The deep learning architecture includes deep neural network (DNN), hybrid long short-term memory (LSTM) and hybrid Bidirectional long short-term memory (BLSTM). The objective and subjective evaluations test showed that quality of synthesized speech of Kham dialect was satisfied.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Super-Resolution Enhancement Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern scientific research, the research of infrared technology has achieved a lot of results, and infrared detectors and other devices have also been widely used. However, infrared images have characteristics such as low contrast, unclear information, and blurred edges, which seriously affect the observation effect of infrared images. In order to better achieve observation and monitoring, it is necessary to optimize and enhance the acquired images. In this paper, the infrared image acquired by FLIR-Tau camera is taken as the research object. According to the characteristics of infrared image and the structure of convolutional neural network, an improved super-resolution convolutional neural network algorithm is proposed to train the algorithm model for infrared image. The infrared image is enhanced by the learning characteristics of the convolutional neural network, which is better than the traditional algorithm in contrast enhancement and detail information enhancement.

articleTitle: Plaintiff's Win Rate in Administrative Proceedings Based on “China Judgment Online”
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Based on written judgments of administrative cases manually collected from "China Judgment Online", the "Microscopic Data Set of Maoming Municipality Administrative Proceedings for 2016" is built to empirically study the influence of the defendant's administrative level on the plaintiff's win rate, verify the correlation between the plaintiff's win rate and the defendant's administrative level in administrative cases happening in Mainland China, and further examine whether the phenomenon of administrative intervention in the judiciary indeed exists in the court's case trial.

articleTitle: A Scheme of STEAM Interactive Learning Toy for Musical and Computational Thinking
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: STEAM education has been paid much attention currently for fostering the interdisciplinary thinking abilities. However, the current learning content of STEAM almost focuses on the learning of STEM subjects and the cultivation of the Computational Thinking (CT), so the learning of ART subject is insufficient. Therefore, this paper proposes a Scheme of STEAM Interactive Learning Toy for Musical Thinking (MT) and Computational Thinking (ILT-MCT), to engage primary level elementary students in learning knowledge and concepts of the MT and CT both. In ILT-MCT scheme, children read the paper-based learning content (learning book) to learn the concepts of MT and CT, interact with a Mobile-based learning toy using substantial Programming Blocks, and further play the digital game-based learning content via the learning toy to enhance the learning motivation.

Author Keywords: Computational Thinking, Musical Thinking, Interactive Learning Toy, Primary Level Elementary Students

articleTitle: Double-Head Attention-Based Convolutional Neural Networks for Text Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Because self-attention captures long-distance features without generating sequence dependence, it has been widely used in machine translation and machine reading comprehension. However, there is a lack of research and exploration on self-attention in text classification research methods. This paper proposes a classification model based on Self-Attention, which applies the self-attention mechanism to text classification tasks reasonably. In addition, based on the self-attention model, we further propose a convolutional neural networks(CNN) based on the double-head attention mechanism. The experimental results show that the double-head attention-based convolutional neural networks (DHACNN) improves the classification accuracy and optimizes the test speed.

articleTitle: The Past, Present, and Future of Media Literacy Education Research Theme: A Network and Cluster Analysis of Literature
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet and social media technology as well as their application in education, media literacy, acting as the necessary means of achieving lifelong learning in the new media environment, will play an important role in education field and even civil society. This article has done network and cluster analysis on media literacy education literature since 2000, reviewed the research development, presented existing research themes, and pointed out some questions that remains to be met, so as to lay a foundation for future research and practice in related fields.

articleTitle: The Research about Film and Television Information Management and Integrated Service
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: China's film industry has made a vigorously progress in recent years, However, in the production of film-making, the related preparatory work is still mainly offline. Practical information systems are urgently needed to promote information exchange and serve film and television practitioners. Firstly, this paper puts forward a design scheme of film and television information management and integrated service system. Secondly, it introduces an online script copyright trading method combining subjective and objective evaluation. Finally, it introduces the innovations of this system. The system satisfies the needs of various types of practitioners in film preparation and designs a script evaluation method based on subjective and objective evaluation, which provides a new opportunity for the development of film and television industry.

Author Keywords: film and television information management, film and television information service system, online script copyright trading, subjective and objective evaluation

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Data Driven Analysis Model for Students' Mastery Level of Knowledge Points Based on Electronic Schoolbag
