publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Students' mastery level of knowledge points is an important indicator reflecting their learning situations. Obtaining the mastery level of knowledge points is an important basis for realizing students' individualized learning and for improving students' learning situation and teachers' teaching quality. Based on the Rasch model, this research constructs the model for students' mastery level of knowledge points based on electronic schoolbag, and excavates and analyzes students' test scores understanding their mastery level of knowledge points. Through the application of this model on two monthly test scores of a middle school, the results confirmed that this model can well characterize students' mastery level of knowledge points. The construction and application the model for students' mastery level of knowledge points based on electronic schoolbag provides reference and ideas for students' individualized learning situation analysis and teacher's refined teaching implementation.

articleTitle: Large-Scale Ubiquitous Learning Design and Practice Basing on Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Currently, data-driven extensive learning extends to K12 disciplines. However, the existing research mainly focuses on the field of higher education, lacking of datadriven large-scale ubiquitous learning teaching research in K12 field. This paper introduces the design and practice of three closed-loop systems of large-scale ubiquitous learning driven by "Zuoyebang Yike" data and hierarchical and efficient interactive classroom.

Author Keywords: ubiquitous learning, data closed loop, hierarchical teaching

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Tourism Congestion Based on Space Syntax and Neural Network Method: A Case Study of Kulangsu Xiamen
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Historical district is the product of space and social factors in the process of urban development, it owns inherent characteristics and patterns. Today, the best way people for the historic district is through travel. Tourism development is an effective way to further develop historical districts. How to maintain a balance between historical district protection and development, how to effectively evaluate planning programs is still an urgent problem to be solved. This study uses space syntax and neural network method to construct the evaluation model of tourism spatial planning congestion. The purpose of the model is to establish an individual behavior-oriented model to understand the interaction between space and pedestrians. Utilizing the advantages of space syntax and neural network method, Kulangsu street accessibility and the traffic flow of multiple attractions are analyzed. Through the model, the conflict between the road choice and the flow of people and the pressure of the attractions attraction are obtained, so as to assess the pros and cons of the status quo, and make recommendations for future improvement based on the obtained results.

Author Keywords: historical district, neural work, space syntax, tourism, Kulangsu island

articleTitle: The 'Network-Based Training with Decreasing Interventions' Strategy for Teachers' Professional Development in Rural Teaching Sites
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Educational equity is impeded because of the low quality of education in rural areas. The low level of rural teachers' professional skills is the main reason for the low quality of education in rural areas. To promote the professional development of teachers in rural teaching sites, and to stimulate and enhance their motivation and ability of self-development, this research proposes a strategy of 'network-based training with decreasing interventions'. This research uses design-based research method. Twenty teachers participated in a six-month network-based training, which was implemented in three phases in Zhou qu, Gansu, China. Results indicate that the strategy of 'network-based training with decreasing interventions' can: (1) promote the teachers' abilities of instructional design and teaching with IT; (2) enhance the teachers' self-confidence and self-esteem, and stimulate their motivation of self-development; and, (3) improve the teachers' abilities of organizing network-based training and self-learning with web resources, and thereby improve their ability of self-development.

Author Keywords: network-based training with decreasing intervention, ability of self-development, motivation of self-development, teacher professional development

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Design Courses Based on Fuzzy Decision-Making Method
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This paper proposes a fuzzy decision-making evaluation model. Taking the evaluation of the industrial design course of a university in China as an example, it is used to solve the problem of complexity or ambiguity in the evaluation of the curriculum effectiveness of non-quantitative multi-standard courses. Firstly, the fuzzy semantic variable is combined with the fuzzy operation to obtain the fuzzy evaluation value of the four non-quantitative scoring standards for the 10 student curriculum design schemes, and the fuzzy sequence method is used to obtain the prioritization results. Finally, the triangular fuzzy diagrams are used to compare and analyze the students in the 4 The degree of performance in the standard and the overall course learning effectiveness show that the evaluation model can effectively help to understand the effectiveness of the course learning.

Author Keywords: education system, performance evaluation of curriculum, fuzzy decision making, triangular fuzzy

articleTitle: A Study of Correlation between Technology Knowledge and Technology Beliefs of EFL Teachers in Junior Middle School
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The deep integration of information technology and curriculum greatly simplifies the process of students' transition from learning knowledge to critical thinking and higher thinking. However, few teachers know how to integrate technology into the classroom teaching to achieve learning goals effectively. Many factors influence the effectiveness of teachers' integration in the classroom, including the technology knowledge and technology beliefs of teachers. This study aims to investigate the level of technology knowledge and technology beliefs of English as foreign language (EFL) teachers in junior middle school and analyze the correlation between them. Based on the TPACK framework and the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM), this study developed the questionnaire to investigate teachers' technology knowledge and technology beliefs. The participants are 206 EFL English teachers in 12 junior middle schools. The findings of this study indicate technology knowledge and technology beliefs of junior middle school EFL teachers have a strong positive correlation. Furthermore, the influence of demographic variables such as gender on teachers' technology knowledge and technology beliefs was also investigated. Based on these findings, suggestions for the EFL teachers' professional development of junior middle school were put forward.

articleTitle: Construction of Converging Media Platform in All Media Times
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the construction scheme of the converging media platform, and expounds how to converge the production of video, audio, text, image and other media such as the Internet and mobile client, especially how to concentrate and present news materials. How to integrate Weibo, WeChat and mobile client to construct the integrated media is researched at the same time.

articleTitle: Japanese Learning System Driven by Video Corpora
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: this paper recommends the Japanese-learning system driven by video corpora on the theoretical basis of Krashen's second language acquisition theory, constructivism teaching view, data-driven learning and grammatical view of lexical items as a center. In addition to that, this paper introduces its application process and components. Finally, based on its trial text results, this paper proved that this video corpora-driven system is advanced and superior to other existing teaching systems and methods that advocate the concept of "learning".

Author Keywords: Video Corpora, Japanese Learning System, Learning, Acquisition

articleTitle: Stage Actor Positioning Method Based on RealSense Point Cloud
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: A novel and convenient method for human positioning based on computer vision is proposed. The new camera Realsense D435 from Intel is used to provide richer and more effective visual information. The positioning problem can be simplified to the conversion problem between point cloud and space coordinate system. Experimental results indicated that only several test points were needed to establish the conversion relationship between the two coordinate systems, thereby obtaining the position of the person. The accuracy meets the demand of the stage performance.

Author Keywords: computer vision, point cloud, space coordinate, visual information, human positioning

articleTitle: Exploring the Design and Implementation of Teachers'Motion Skills Assessment Task
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to explore the ability level of teachers in motor skills by simulating interactive animation situations and designing situational tests with subject software. In this paper, with the help of Geogebra software, the situational evaluation task designed by "the proof of a right triangle" is used to collect the measured operational data in the key operation link by using "running javascript mark", so that the evaluation task has interactive ability and data. The acquisition ability, from the perspective of analyzing operational behavior, uses the lag sequential analysis method to explore the behavioral logic revealed by the tested teachers in the process of completing the situational assessment task, and visually analyze the behavioral path of the teacher's overall and individual. Eighteen mathematics teachers from junior high school participated in the assessment task and obtained the corresponding data for analysis. The experimental results show that there are significant differences among the tested teachers in task operation proficiency, task completion, teacher age and teaching age, and the performance of the overall teachers in the key links of the operation can be seen through the behavior path visualization map.

Author Keywords: Geogebra software, Motion skill, Situational assessment

articleTitle: Ethics to Prepare Educators for Professional Service Robots in Classrooms
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This paper outlines ethical principles for educators preparing for service robots in the classroom (professional service robots). At the dawn of artificial intelligence (AI) as service robots arrive in education systems, we first define robots and professional service robots. We then review and suggest a conduct-focused ethics path over individual moral path to guide educators to consider ethics and key ethical issues involved in professional service robot design, development, implementation and partnering efforts for education settings. Borrowing from the robot ethics (roboethics) fields that has emerged from computer science and bioethics, we suggest that educators new to classroom robots and AI can ethically reduce the complexity of their work by considering simple social impact issues, specifically human relations and job issues at this early stage in professional robot thinking. We conclude by offering ethics of care principles and culture research to help educators who may adopt a caring stance to work in the diverse global context of robotics and education today.

Author Keywords: service robots, ethics, care ethics, learning design, artificial intelligence, education leadership, education technology

articleTitle: The Effect of 360-Degree Video Authentic Materials on EFL Learners' Listening Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Although the increased use of authentic materials in listening comprehension teaching has become general practice, it is crucial to find out whether or not the new technology-supported authentic material could be beneficial to English as a Foreign Language (EFL) learners' listening comprehension. The present study examined the effect of authentic material presentation modes (the traditional presentation mode versus virtual reality mode) on EFL learners' English listening comprehension and cognitive load. Subjects were 53 English major sophomores of a university in Wuhan. The control group received the common traditional video playback (the traditional presentation mode) and the experimental group were provided material on Head-Mounted Display (HMD) by 360-degree video playback (the virtual reality mode). The same authentic video material-360-degree video journalism was used in the two groups. The results demonstrated that the EFL learners who watched 360-degree video journalism encountered higher cognitive load and did not outperform in English listening comprehension test than those who watched the material in traditional presentation mode. Pedagogical implications for English listening teaching were provided at the end of the study.

articleTitle: Study on the Application of Robot-Assisted Education in Industrial Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This paper summarizes the background of robot research and application in China and abroad, concludes the national policies regarding robots in recent years, and categorizes the application of robots in education. Subsequently, after a literature review on the robot research at home and abroad, we have found that applying robots in educational activities can help improve teaching effects and unlock students' enthusiasm for learning. Therefore, based on the educational features of industrial design, humanoid robots are used for program and curriculum design to establish a robot-assisted educational design model. Classroom teaching is conducted based on three robot-assisted models, providing reference for the theory and practice study on robot-assisted teaching in the future.

articleTitle: Emoji Usage and Interpersonal Relationship in Computer-Mediated Cmmunication
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Based on 514 one-to-one chat corpus generated by 1028 interlocutors, this paper analyzed the way Chinese used emojis in computer-based communication (CMC) and explored whether interpersonal factors would affect people's emoji usage. The study found that people using emoji in instant messaging had formed certain customary features and preferences. People would concentrate on using a few emojis which occupied a large proportion of the total number of emojis used in daily communication. They were keen to use one type of emojis instead of multiple emojis at a time, and preferred to use emoji at the end of the turn or alone, and seldom put it at the beginning or middle of the turn. In addition, we found that different styles of emojis would affect the circumstances under which they appeared, which provided an angle for analyzing the usages and functions of different emojis. Studies also confirmed that as a key element of daily conversation, interpersonal relationships also influenced the way people used emoji in CMC. When communicating with people with higher intimacy, netizens tended to use more diverse and richer emojis; when users communicated with more alienated people, the types of emojisused were limited. In terms of the way to express information, compared with communicating with family members, close friends, classmates and colleagues, netizens were less likely to use emoji to convey information and more likely to use notional words in face of casual acquaintances, so as to avoid poor communication caused by different interpretations of emojis.

articleTitle: Critical Success Factors (CSFs) of Distance Learning Systems: A Literature Assessment
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Numerous e-learning systems have been established in the past decades, which are evolved from the private or institutionalized system into an open and global system, and depends on the social and technological environment. The aim of this study is to identify the critical success factors (CSFs) of distance learning systems from the perspective of students. An extensive study from the past nineteen years' works of literature was accomplished to determined 45 distance learning systems' CSFs that were distributed into 6 categories. The first category includes the investigation into students' ability and needs. The second category is the factors that an instructor must-have. Online learning contents' characteristics are the third category. The fourth is focus on the requirement of the technology infrastructure and its capability. Finally, support was distinguished into two main categories, such as system support and institutional management support. The results of this study give perspectives into the factors that should be considered, by an educational institution anywhere around the world, when developing a successful distance learning system.

Author Keywords: e-learning, distance learning, critical success factors

articleTitle: Affective Computing Oriented to Intelligent Education — Reflection and Prospect
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence technology is in the third wave of development, and "AI + education" is the important direction of the development of AI technology. Affective computing, as an important field of AI research, has strong application prospects in the field of education because of its interactivity, pertinence and security. At present, it plays an important role in the five fields including intelligent education environment, intelligent learning process support and so on, because of its interactivity, pertinence and security, at present, it plays an important role in five fields such as intelligent education environment, intelligent learning process support and so on. At the same time, the affective computing application itself has some technical difficulties, but also involves the right of privacy, portraiture right and other issues.

Author Keywords: AI, affective computing, human – computer interaction, education

articleTitle: What Motives Learner to Learn in MOOC? An Investigation of Chinese University MOOC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Learning motivation plays an important role in improving the learning quality of MOOC learners. An investigation and analysis of the learning motivation of 1562 Chinese University MOOC (i-Course) learners was conducted by using Unconstrained Adult Online Learning Motivation Scale. The results show that the levels of learning motivation in the six dimensions, which are cognitive interest, career development, interpersonal relationship, getting rid of routine, external influence and social service. All six of them are in the upper-middle level. Among them, the motivation level of cognitive interest and social service are higher than others. Beacuse of this, the curriculum should take specific measures.

articleTitle: An Influencing Factors Model of Self-Regulated Learning of Adult in Web-Based Learning Space
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: From the perspective of lifelong learning, promoting adult learners' self-regulated learning by using information technology effectively is crucial important to the creation of the learning society. It is necessary to conduct in-depth study on the factors affecting the self-regulated learning of adult when using web-based learning space. This study deeply integrated technology acceptance theory and self-regulated learning theory, on the basis of which constructed an influencing factors model of self-regulated learning of adult in web-based learning space. This study selected 670 adult learners who participated in public welfare courses as the research objects, the structural equation model(SEM) analysis method is used to test and modify the model. The results show that openness to experience, risk propensity, technical support availability and external equipment accessibility can affect the self-regulated learning of adult when using web-based learning space, finally, the study put forward relevant strategies to promote the self-regulated learning of adult learners when using web-based learning space.

articleTitle: Research on the Curriculum Objectives and System Construction of Media Literacy in Basic Education in the Era of Omnimedia
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: 5G is a revolutionary technology. It not only transforms the main communication methods of the society from writing to video language, but also changes the communication rules and construction methods of information transmission. It not only has a great impact on the field of mass communication, but also has a subversive change in the subject structure of media education. The innovation of the 5G technology has promoted the transformation of human society into the "four full media" (full-course media, holographic media, all-member media and full-effect media). Media literacy has become a core force in citizen literacy during the omnimedia era. The literacy education of media in the basic educational stage has an enlightening nature and is in a basic position in the universal media literacy education system. The objects of basic education at present stage are those newcomers born since the year of 2010 and they have grown up in the process of vigorous development of the whole media. In order to make media literacy education better serve the basic education and make those newcomers fully understand and use omnimedia, this article first analyzes the new demands and new norms of media literacy in the era of omnimedia, and then, followed by "beyond protectionism" as value needs, analyzes the purposes of media literacy education under the perspective of omnimedia, and finally establishes the framework of media literacy education system in the time of 5G technology. This article believes that we should position the goal of media literacy education in basic education as an enlightenment education to cultivate students' "rational analysis", a comprehensive literacy ability to cultivate learners' media cognition, media analysis and media use.

Author Keywords: We Media, Media Literacy Education, Targets, System of Contents

articleTitle: The Speech Synthesis of Yi Language Based on DNN
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: This paper is mainly about a speech synthesis system based on Deep Neural Network (DNN) model of Yi languages, a kind of minority language in China. The system is composed of relatively complete text analysis of Yi, model training and speech synthesis module. Especially in front-end, the word segmentation, pause handling, word-to-phoneme conversion and label processing are used to analysis text of Yi language. We designed the question set for decision tree of DNN model training and used vocoder: WORLD for synthesis. The system achieves a relatively good Mean Opinion Score (MOS) of 3.93 by Yi undergraduates as evaluators compared with a MOS of 4.58 of original speech. To investigate the factors affecting the quality of synthesized Yi speech, this paper also objectively evaluates the performance of different training set and DNN model. The system successfully synthesized Yi speech for the first time and synthesized speech is relatively good as the result of an only complete minority language speech synthesis system.

articleTitle: Emotion Classification of Film and Television Scene Images for Audiences
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The purpose of the research on emotion classification of film and television (TV) scene images is to hope that the computer can simulate the audience's emotional perception to judge positive or negative emotional trends of the image. In this paper, from the perspective of emotional semantics, a method of the emotion classification about the film and TV scene image is proposed. Firstly, the film and TV scene image dataset were established and assessed based on the subjective evaluation experiment. Then the theory of psychology and photographic art was used to extract image emotional features. Finally, particle swarm optimization (PSO)-support vector machine (SVM) algorithm based on feature importance dimension reduction was used for building the classifier. The experimental results show that the image dataset initially established in this paper can be helpful to the subsequent study on emotion classification of the film and TV scene image, and the accuracy of the positive and negative emotion classifier on this dataset is 0.87, which conforms to audience's emotional perception of the film and TV scene image.

Author Keywords: film and TV scene image dataset, image emotion feature extraction, image emotion classification

articleTitle: The Effect of Virtual Museum on Students' Cognitive and Non-Cognitive Abilities: From the Perspective of Multimedia Learning Theory
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Based on the theory of multimedia learning, an artwork exhibition system that integrates digital media art instruction with virtual museum was designed as an auxiliary teaching tool for digital media major, and the cognitive and non-cognitive abilities of three groups of participants was explored: artwork exhibition, panoramic roaming and multimodal PPT. The participants were 81 students majoring in digital media arts, and a quasi-experimental research design was employed. Several cognitive ability factors of the students aided with different tools were evaluated, including information processing, perceptual expression, learning transfer and reflection. Several non-cognitive ability factors were also evaluated, including learning motivation, knowledge construction, and self-management. The results showed that compared with the other two groups of participants, the artwork exhibition assisted learning effectively improved students' non-cognitive abilities such as motivation and attitude in the learning process, deepened their understanding of knowledge, promoted learning transfer and enhanced practical skills. The presentation mode of the work exhibition based on the theory of multimedia learning is more beneficial to cultivating students' cognitive and non-cognitive abilities.

articleTitle: Investigating Interactive Behaviors in Online Community of Inquiry Using Social Network Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The main purpose of this research was to study the interactive behaviors of learners in the online community of inquiry, and then proposed the strategies of intervention teaching from the perspective of the community of inquiry (COI) theory, for teachers to design learning activities suitable for learners. The research adopted the method of social network analysis to analyze 623 posts of the online community of inquiry, which were generated by 54 first-year graduate students during one semester of learning science and technology on the Knowledge Forum6 platform. The features of learners' social network structure were extracted, and from the three dimensions of network structure, centrality and cohesion subgroup, founding that s2, s12, s3 and s4 were the core members of the network, able to initiate topics and communicate with others actively, master more learning resources and have a great influence in the community. However, s13 and s43 were fringe members who spoke little in the community and were easily overlooked. From the perspective of the COI theory, this paper put forward several teaching intervention strategies.

articleTitle: Research on STEAM Courses Multi-Dimensional Learning Activities Design
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The abilities with information literacy as the core are the 21st century skills that students should possess to adapt to life-long development and social development. STEAM education integrates multi-disciplinary and multi-field contents, cultivates students' information literacy, and promotes their abilities of collaboration, communication, innovation and development. Based on STEAM educational idea, this study constructs a "STEAM courses learning activity design framework" and applies it in teaching. Taking the comprehensive practice activities as an example, this study conducted a group experiment for two classes of senior high school sophomores. The data show that the students have great improvement in the three aspects of information literacy, communication and cooperation, and practical innovation ability, so as to achieve the goal of promoting the students' ability to improve the information literacy as the core, and can meet the needs of the students' experiential learning and understanding learning and the synchronous development.

Author Keywords: STEAM, learning activity design, 21st century skills, computer mediated environment

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Learning Intervention on Learning Behavior of Learners in MOOC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: As a new form of education, MOOC has attracted a large number of learners to participate in the study, but the problems of high rate of dropout, poor sustainability, and low qualification rate are more prominent. Based on the RTI three-level intervention model, this study constructs the MOOC learning intervention research framework, combines the learning process data of the two types of learners under the constraints and non-constrained conditions, and uses the comparative analysis method to compare the learning behaviors of the two types of learners. A horizontal comparison is made to analyze the effect of learning intervention on the learning behavior of MOOC learners. Studies have shown that appropriate learning interventions have a positive effect on learning retention, learning engagement, depth of interaction, and learning outcomes in the MOOC learning process.

Author Keywords: learning intervention, MOOC, data analysis, learning behavior, comparative research

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of User Continuance Intention in Mobile Video Live Broadcast Platforms: Based on the Perspective of User Experience
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: For the booming mobile video live broadcast industry, enhancing user stickiness and increasing user continuance intention are the key to their future development. From the perspective of user experience, combining the Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) and some related demand theory, this paper constructs a theoretical model of influencing factors of user continuance intention in mobile video live broadcast platforms. The descriptive statistical analysis of 411 valid questionnaire data shows that the current user experience level and the intention to continue using the mobile video live broadcast platform are not high. The results of structural equation model (SEM) analysis show that user experience and need fulfillment have a significant positive impact on the user continuance intention. Perceived ease of use and perceived hedonic quality indirectly influence the user continuance intention through the mediating role of user experience, while perceived usefulness has no significant impact on user experience and user continuance intention, need fulfillment also has no significant impact on user experience. Finally, through crosstab analysis, it is found that some users' demographic characteristics and some usage environment variables are correlated with the user experience level.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Practical Effects of Two Typical Learning Modes about Massive Open Online Courses
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: There are two typical learning modes in the massive online open courses, including full online learning and blended learning. It is hot spot and great significance to research the practical effects of both with empirical research methods. Based on the massive online open course "Modern Educational Technology", this paper forms two typical learning modes which named full online learning mode and blended learning mode, and then uses empirical research methods to explore the differences between the both, including cognitive learning, emotional learning, skills learning, learning situation. Finally, combined with the research conclusion, the author puts forward the reasons about the differences in order to provide the evidence for teachers and learners to properly select the appropriate learning model.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Flow Theory in Primary Mathematics Teaching in Tibetan Areas in China
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: In this paper, we argue that the application of flow theory in primary mathematics in Tibetan areas in China with the support of immersive virtual reality system is benefit for improving the level and effectiveness of mathematics teaching and enhancing primary school students' mathematical literacy. The flow refers to a psychological experience when students are engaged in a learning activity with a balance of challenge and skill in a task, and fascinated by the activity they pay high attention to, achieving a kind of integration of activity and consciousness. Meanwhile, the immersive virtual reality system with a virtual character and a natural interaction mode can provide appropriate curriculum resources for teachers and students, and guide them to immerse themselves in an efficient teaching and learning activity. With the application of flow theory and the introduction of immersive virtual reality system, Students in primary school can achieve a learning state of efficient epistemic dialogue and strong learning motivation.

articleTitle: The Use and Education of New Media on Chinese Urban Elderly
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: The popularization of new media has enabled increasing individuals, including the urban elderly, to use these new media. The accelerative use of new media by the elderly, along with their insufficient media literacy, deeply affects the happiness in their later lives. This study focuses on the gratification and its influencing factors in elderly group. How to carry out the improvement of new media literacy education of the elderly is also studied by understanding their needs for new media equipment. This study is based on Uses and Gratifications theory, with literature investigations, questionnaire surveys, and in-depth interviews as research methods. Through statistical analysis of the questionnaire data and interviews, it is concluded that the age, gender, education background and attitudes towards aging separately exerts influences on the usage of new media gratification. Moreover, five gratification dimensions of gratification, which are respectively defined as, entertainment gratification, social gratification, and learning gratification, and escapism gratification and self-cognition gratification, in the usage of new media by the elderly were analyzed. Also, the elderly has diversified demands on the visual and aural effects, interfaces, input methods, operating systems, content interestingness, information usefulness, property security, and privacy security. According to the research results, possible measures of new media literacy education for the elderly are proposed. The younger generation plays the role of digital feedbacks to encourage the elderly to embrace new functions and integrate into the new media environment with a positive attitude. From the perspective of communities, carrying out new media classes and competitions would be an effective way to promote the use of new media by elderly groups. Providers of new media should develop products that fit the physiological and psychological needs of the urban elderly.

articleTitle: The Construction of the Evaluation System of the Application Ability of Primary and Secondary Teachers
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: With the rapid develohpment of education informatization, education departments all over the world pay more and more attention to evaluate teachers' information technology application ability. In order to improve teachers' information technology application ability, teachers' information technology application ability was accurately trained according to the evaluation results. Therefore, based on Thinkphp framework, this study designs and implements an intelligent evaluation system for teachers' information technology application ability. On the basis of theoretical analysis, literature review and project analysis, this paper puts forward an intelligent evaluation framework for primary and secondary school teachers'information technology application ability. This paper studies the conceptual framework, formal model, operational mechanism and feature analysis of the evaluation framework, designs and develops an intelligent evaluation platform, and makes a detailed analysis of its functional framework, operational mechanism and technical framework.

articleTitle: Study on the Teaching Mode and Effect of Technical Support for English Words in Primary Schools
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Word learning is the cornerstone of language acquisition. For primary school students who are still in their early stages, how to quickly master the entry vocabularies and stimulate their interest on English learning has become an urgent obstacle in primary English teaching. The continuous promotion and popularization of media technology in domestic classrooms has brought new opportunities for the innovation of language teaching mode. In recent years, the research on multimedia language teaching is common, but the research on multimedia language teaching for students with low school age is rare, and empirical research is especially scarce. Therefore, based on Meyer's multimedia learning theory and second language acquisition theory, the paper not only introduces multimedia technology into English vocabulary teaching, constructs a scientific and complete multimedia teaching model of English words in primary schools, but also carries out an experimental study combining qualitative and quantitative research. Compared with the traditional word teaching mode, the multi-angle and multi-aspect interactive teaching mode supported by multimedia technology can improve students' learning initiative and stimulate learners' interest in learning. The flexible application of multiple teaching methods can make up for the deficiency of traditional teaching mode. The rich and colorful information input under the combination of various technical presentation modes can consolidate learners' memory of word content, and the vivid vocabulary application environment can enhance learners' ability to use vocabulary. Most of the primary school students have a positive attitude towards the vocabulary teaching mode supported by multimedia technology, and it is believed that the multimedia word teaching mode is better than the traditional vocabulary teaching mode.

Author Keywords: multimedia technology, primary school students, English word teaching

articleTitle: Exploring the Relationship between Online Learning Activities and Learning Performance in MOOC
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: Up to date, it remains unclear whether a connection exists between online learning activities and learning performance. This study is devoted to analyzing the relationship between online learning activities and learning performance in MOOC. Learners who have participated in 3 certain courses in Chinese University MOOC participated in the research. A total of 352 questionnaires were received. 292 valid questionnaires were collected in this study. The data is analyzed by SPSS and AMOS. The results show that independent variable guidance activities, creative work activities, interaction activities and feedback activities all have a significant effect on the learning performance of dependent variables. However, at the same time, there are some activities that have no significant effect on a certain dimension of learning performance.

articleTitle: Study on the Design of Evaluation Task and Implementation of Teachers'Attitude Towards the Application of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2019 International Joint Conference on Information, Media and Engineering (IJCIME)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the evaluation of teachers' information technology application competence has caused the attention of the relevant experts and scholars in this field all over the world. Based on this, this study was carried out empirical research on teachers' attitudes towards the application of information technology and explored the design method and implementation strategies for the task of emotional attitude assessment. First of all, based on the technology acceptance model, this study determines the dimensions of teachers' attitudes towards the application of information technology. Secondly, the design process and basic structure of the emotional attitude assessment tasks are determined. In the end, three dimensions of the implementation of the assessment strategies are determined, including Value Identity, Cost Identity, and Usage Intention. The results show that the assessment of teachers' attitudes towards IT application can be carried out by designing assessment tasks, determining assessment situations, and using relevant assessment platforms. This study is also expecting to provide some theoretical and practical reference for improving the assessment of teachers' attitudes toward information technology application in underdeveloped areas.

Author Keywords: primary and secondary school mathematics teachers, Emotional Attitudes, Evaluation Task
